variants.title: Optical tweezers with a 2 micrometre bead
variants.method: equipartition, power spectrum and Stokes drag
variants.note: A bead of twice the diameter has four times the Stokes drag at the same viscosity, so its corner frequency is lower and its stiffness per milliwatt is the lab's own 3 micronewtons per metre.

source.title: Illustrative design values
source.note: set by the lab for this condition; not taken from a named product's datasheet

variants.title: Optical tweezers in a viscous liquid
variants.sample: 1 micrometre silica bead in a viscous water-glycerol mixture (3 mPa s, the lab's own value)
variants.method: equipartition, power spectrum and Stokes drag
variants.note: A viscosity of 3 mPa s is the lab's own illustrative value, unsourced: three times water. The corner frequency is three times lower, and the viscosity can be read from it.

source.title: Unsourced / illustrative
source.note: the 3 mPa s viscosity is not a looked-up value for a named mixture
